label: GDP per capita
note: Roughly a threefold rise in real income per person, sustained across four decades of rapid population growth.

label: Electricity generated
note: From one ageing dam to four major hydropower stations on the Nile — a thirty-four-fold rise in installed capacity.

label: National poverty rate
note: Two in three Ugandans lifted clear of poverty as measured against the national line.

label: Refugees hosted
note: The largest refugee-hosting nation in Africa, under one of the most progressive refugee laws in the world.

label: Years of stability
note: Four decades of unbroken constitutional order — the foundation on which every other figure rests.
